info.name: Multi-Courier Integration Platform — Unified API
info.description:
One unified API in front of many courier partners. Every request body carries `courier_partner`; the rest of the payload is this platform's own normalized schema, identical for every courier.

Example responses on the create / track / cancel requests are **verbatim captures from live calls** against UrbaneBolt UAT (https://uat.urbanebolt.in) — see docs/urbanebolt-uat-samples.md in the repo.

Setup: set the `base_url` variable (default http://localhost:3000). Run "Create order" first — it stores `order_id` and `awb_number` into collection variables for the track/cancel requests.

request.description: 200 when MongoDB is connected, 503 otherwise. Also lists the registered couriers.

request.description: Current status plus the full append-only history. Accepts either your `order_id` or our `internal_order_id`. If the courier is unreachable, the last known state is served rather than failing the read.
Cancels a shipment before pickup. Idempotent — cancelling twice returns 200 again. Cancelling a delivered shipment returns 409 INVALID_STATE.

request.description: Up to 100 orders. Each may target a different `courier_partner`. Returns 202 immediately with a `batch_id`; the orders are processed off the request path with bounded concurrency. Poll `status_url` for per-order outcomes.

response.name: 202 Accepted
400 Too many orders

request.description: Per-order outcomes. `DUPLICATE` means that `order_id` had already been processed, so no second shipment was created — the idempotency guarantee, visible in the response. Every failed item carries a normalized `error_code` and a human-readable `reason` (our wording; the courier's raw error is logged, never returned).

response.name: 200 Completed with errors (partial success)
200 Idempotent resubmission (all duplicates)
